signal: Stampli launched Deep Finance and raised a Blackstone-led Series D, expanding into the SMB market with Stampli Edge

email.body1:
William, saw Stampli launched Deep Finance and pushed into the SMB market with Stampli Edge.

When the target list expands like that, follow-up volume usually outruns what an SDR can personally keep up with, and good accounts slip between touches. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to 3 of your top strategic accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
William, quick follow-up for Stampli.

Most strategic SDRs I talk to are buried in follow-ups and ramp pressure, so the sequencing tweaks that actually move reply rates never get tested. A few small changes usually outperform adding another tool.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
William, last bit of proof for Stampli.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli's reply rate likely compares to peer B2B software teams. Want to grab a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
William, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your plate is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know strategic SDR weeks fill up fast, and not every initiative makes the cut.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Stampli either way.
